# AI for Code

> > Comprehensive directory and rankings of AI coding tools, agents, and assistants including Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf, and Gemini CLI.

AI for Code provides expert evaluations, comparisons, and guides for AI-powered development tools. The site covers code completion assistants, autonomous coding agents, IDE integrations, and specialized tools for testing, code review, and language-specific development across VS Code, JetBrains, and AI-native editors.

## Key Topics

- Cursor
- GitHub Copilot
- Claude Code
- Windsurf
- Gemini CLI
- Sourcegraph Cody
- Agentic workflows
- Code completion
- AI coding assistants
- VS Code integration
- Multi-file editing
- SWE-bench benchmarks
- Enterprise development
- AI-native IDEs
- Code review automation
